mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% in a single month, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers Federal Reserve policy accommodation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (supply) and housing starts (demand) signal broad economic contraction that prompts market expectations of aggressive monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO and HOUST both decline > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), higher discount rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in residential sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand that signals improving corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95.0 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals severe supply-side contraction that triggers recession fears, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rises in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate labor market contraction coinciding with monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks escalate.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline > 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.1% MoM
regime_hint: labor market contraction with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines > 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% MoM, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), the market prices in accommodative monetary policy to stimulate employment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks diminish.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.
